apps/agents/skills/connections.description: Declare and use shared app-level Calendar, Mail, Slack, and OAuth connections in Notion Apps.

apps/agents/skills/custom-blocks.description: Build interactive browser custom blocks declared by a Notion App.

apps/agents/skills/notion-as-code.description: Declare Notion pages, databases, teamspaces, and custom agents in an App, including data sources used by syncs.

apps/agents/skills/sketch.description: Sketch an App workflow as a reviewable flow diagram when planning or iterating on its design with the user.

apps/agents/skills/sync.description: Build, debug, or review Notion App database syncs with stable keys and resumable pagination.

apps/agents/skills/workflow.description: Build or review Notion App workflows for typed triggers, durable replay-safe steps, and idempotent effects.

plugins/antigravity/skills/notion-meetin.description: Prepares meeting agendas, internal pre-reads, and decision briefs using Notion context and relevant research. Use for preparing the next or upcoming meeting, meeting preparation, recurring meeting context, or updating meeting outcomes; use knowledge-capture for a standalone record of an existing discussion.

workers/agents/skills/auth-guide.description: Guide to setting up third-party authentication for a Notion Worker. Covers brokered credentials for external-service API keys / personal access tokens, OAuth, and plaintext environment secrets only when worker code needs the value. Use when the worker needs credentials for a non-Notion API, not for Notion API tokens or `ntn login`.

workers/agents/skills/custom-blocks.description: Build interactive UI inside Notion connected to workspace data. Covers creating, modifying, and troubleshooting custom blocks from project setup through deployment.

workers/agents/skills/sync-debug.description: Diagnose a failing or misbehaving sync — fetch run logs, identify errors, cross-reference with code, and suggest fixes

workers/agents/skills/sync-guide.description: Comprehensive guide to building Notion Workers syncs — covers the two-sync architecture (backfill+delta), replace mode, pagination, consistency buffers, pacers, deletion strategies, and common pitfalls. Auto-loads when sync-related work is detected.

workers/agents/skills/sync-validate.description: Review a sync capability for common bugs — cursor advancement, pagination termination, state persistence, bi-modal correctness, consistency buffers, and deletion handling

workers/agents/skills/sync.description: Scaffold a new sync capability with guided setup — asks about data source, mode, pagination, and cursor design, then generates working code

workers/agents/skills/workflow-guide.description: Reference for typed triggers, durable steps, replay-safe data flow, and idempotent Workflow effects.

workers/agents/skills/workflow-validate.description: Review Notion Worker Workflows for trigger typing and retry safety.

workers/agents/skills/workflow.description: Scaffold a Notion Worker Workflow with typed triggers and replay-safe durable steps.
